```sql
SELECT 
    sum(
        CASE 
            WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN o.item_subtotal * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE o.item_subtotal 
        END
    ) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates fx ON o.order_date = fx.rate_date
WHERE o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND o.marketing_channel = 'email'
  AND o.order_date >= '2025-11-01'
  AND o.order_date <= '2025-11-30';
```
